_instructions.purpose: Test input JSON simulating an LLM semantic router extracting NASA PSI combustion parameters for THM-02.
how_to_run_cli: 1. Place 'compute_mixture_transport_and_lewis_number.py' and 'test_thm02_llm_input.json' in the same folder.
3. Run with this LLM JSON file and print output: python compute_mixture_transport_and_lewis_number.py --input test_thm02_llm_input.json
4. Run and save results to a response JSON file: python compute_mixture_transport_and_lewis_number.py --input test_thm02_llm_input.json --output thm02_response.json

expected_verification_checks.primary_payload_case: Stoichiometric CH4 in Lunar Habitat atmosphere (70.3 kPa / 10.2 psi, 30% O2 oxidizer) -> Le should be ~0.95-1.02 (Neutral / Equidiffusive) and D_im should be ~1.44x higher than at 101.325 kPa ISS pressure.
expected_verification_checks.batch_scenario_1: ACME Flame-Ball / Lean H2-O2-CO2 -> Le < 0.45 (Thermo-Diffusively Unstable / Cellular Risk).
expected_verification_checks.batch_scenario_2: FLEX n-Heptane droplet with Helium suppressant dilution -> High thermal conductivity k (~0.11 W/mK) and Le > 3.5 (Diffusively Damped / Quench-Prone).
expected_verification_checks.batch_scenario_3: FLEX n-Heptane droplet with CO2 suppressant dilution -> Much lower thermal conductivity k (~0.025 W/mK) and Le ~ 1.4-1.7 (Thermal Heat-Sink Suppression).

investigation_context.user_query_summary: Compare methane-oxygen-nitrogen transport properties and Lewis number under proposed reduced-pressure Lunar habitat conditions (10.2 psi, 30% O2 oxidizer).
investigation_context.extracted_run_reference: ACME Spherical Burner Benchmark (Synthetic/Derived Parameter Set)
